d: Huawei SFP-10G-iLR is a hot-pluggable 10 Gbps SFP+ optical transceiver designed for high-speed Ethernet connectivity over single-mode fiber. It operates at a wavelength of 1310 nm , supports 10GBASE-iLR , provides transmission distances of up to 1.4 km , uses a duplex LC connector , and supports Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM). It is compatible with a wide range of Huawei enterprise switches and routers.
